title: Direct TPM is option-dependent
content: The G20 tyre monitoring arrangement can report separate pressures per wheel when equipped with direct TPMS. The value appearing on the dashboard does not prove it can be obtained through standard emissions OBD.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: What tire pressure to use
content: Compare current displayed tyre pressures with the car’s displayed targets or tyre placard and mounted tyre configuration. Target pressure varies with tyre specification and load. Do not invent universal BMW 330i pressure values.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Temperature and tire pressure
content: Pressure changes as tire temperature and ambient conditions change. A warning during cold weather can reflect a real reduced pressure; the driver should verify against official owner instructions.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Fluid level availability
content: A warning or switch signal for brake-fluid level does not imply continuous fluid volume measurement. Treat readings and warnings as distinct and do not provide hydraulic repair steps.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Brake pressure cannot prove brake safety
content: Brake hydraulic control systems may internally use pressure measurements, but access depends on the ECU and diagnostic tool. Normal-looking live pressure alone cannot clear a pedal or leakage complaint.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Heat management architecture
content: Engine management uses coolant and cylinder-head temperature inputs to manage coolant routing via an actuated heat-management module in relevant B46TU/B48TU applications. The system is more complex than a simple temperature-to-fan mapping.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Temperature and traffic
content: Elevated coolant readings with little vehicle motion can guide questions about airflow, coolant circulation and fan control, but do not establish fan failure without further evidence.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Fan command versus speed
content: A percent fan demand or PWM output is a commanded value; it is not a measured fan RPM. Label these channels separately and report unavailable feedback honestly.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Overheat response
content: A credible engine-overheating warning or rapidly rising temperature calls for stopping safely and following the vehicle-specific owner guidance. Never open hot coolant caps.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Module voltage is not terminal voltage
content: Standard Mode 01 PID 42 concerns control-module electrical voltage. It is useful but not identical to a multimeter reading at a battery post or an IBS-reported battery voltage.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Crank events need appropriate logging
content: Engine speed during starting can be brief. Low-rate generic OBD polling may miss it, even when engine RPM is available during normal running.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: PHEV auxiliary system is different
content: An online G20 training section explains a PHEV auxiliary battery and alternate starting path. Do not copy that design to the petrol-only 330i without correct vehicle data.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Recall 25V636000 model-year scope
content: A US manufacturer recall lists some BMW 330i vehicles in model years 2019–2021 for starter-relay corrosion and possible thermal damage. It includes a park-outside advisory for affected vehicles; VIN verification is essential.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Recall 26V056000
content: A separate US campaign involves some 3 Series vehicles with an engine starter overheating risk. Check the full listed models and the actual VIN, do not mark every G20 as recalled.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Engine-management DME data
content: The engine DME integrates vehicle and engine sensor inputs and controls actuators. An airflow reading may be measured or substituted using other variables in fault conditions.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Air mass OBD support
content: Generic PID 10 is an available standardized command for mass airflow, but whether a particular G20 returns it must be detected rather than assumed.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Fuel pressure labels
content: Fuel pressure values may refer to different circuits, units and pressure references. The direct-injection engine has high-pressure rail sensing; never label generic low-side PID 0A as actual rail pressure without verification.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Misfire evidence
content: Fault codes, monitor counters and symptoms are distinct observations. Distinguish present/pending/historical codes and collect operating context; avoid definitive fault attribution without tests.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Region affects recall lists
content: A US NHTSA model-year match is not proof a German-market vehicle is affected. BMW and KBA recall lookup should be used for the local market and VIN.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Three levels of data availability
content: Physical sensor presence does not imply generic OBD access. Distinguish manufacturer tools and simulated channels, and report supported PIDs explicitly.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: Know which BMW manual applies
content: Some BMW G20 training material discusses the 330e plug-in-hybrid electrical machine and auxiliary battery. The 330i petrol model has different components; require system applicability metadata.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.

title: No ECU write commands for hackathon
content: Read-only data, customer photos and warnings are sufficient for an educational demo. Avoid actuator control, programming, coding and clearing codes as automatic agent actions.
safety_note: Educational triage; verify VIN and official current manual.
